3182.title: Mobile landscape sidebar leaves one thread row
3182.rootCauseOneLine: The non-shrinking navigation keeps its intrinsic height while the flexible thread list receives only the remaining short-viewport space.
3182.proposedFix: Choose a short-viewport thread-space invariant, then make navigation auto-disclose lower-priority rows or scroll within a cap while preserving active and plugin rows.
3182.caveats: Verified in Chrome mobile emulation rather than iOS Safari; the measured layout and source mechanism reproduced identically in two clean stores.
